_about: Longer LK5 Pro on Klipper, stock MK8-style Bowden hotend (PTFE to the nozzle), 0.3 mm nozzle, PLA. Starting values, not yet tuned by test prints.
_flow_points_note: Flow (mm3/s) -> temperature (C). Guess from published stock-Ender-3 (MK8) melt data and our own prints: Fast at ~9 mm3/s under-extrudes below ~205 C. Replace with a measured flow test.
_rates_note: From klippy.log: full-power heating ~0.7 C/s and heater-off cooling ~0.35 C/s near 190-210 C. While printing the heater already runs ~74% (peaks 98%), so usable extra heating is much lower.
